changeSet.author: TKlok
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Issue') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Issue]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [IssueTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [AssetID] [bigint] NULL, [AssetTypeID] [int] NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_Issue_UpdatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [CommentID] [int] NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_Issue_Uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [CompletedOn] [datetime] NULL, [CompletedBy] [int] NULL, [InitiatorID] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Issue] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Issue_IssueType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Issue] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Issue_IssueType] FOREIGN KEY([IssueTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[IssueType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Issue] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Issue_IssueType] END
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Issue' and COLUMN_NAME = 'InitiatorID') begin alter table [dbo].[Issue] add [InitiatorID] int null end
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Issue' and COLUMN_NAME = 'AssetID') begin alter table [dbo].[Issue] add AssetID bigint null; end
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Issue' and COLUMN_NAME = 'AssetTypeID') begin alter table [dbo].[Issue] add AssetTypeID int null; end
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Issue' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Object') begin alter table [dbo].[Issue] alter column [Object] [varchar](50) NULL; alter table [dbo].[Issue] alter column [ObjectID] [int] NULL; alter table [dbo].[Issue] alter column [ObjectType] [varchar](25) NULL; alter table [dbo].[Issue] alter column [ObjectTypeID] [int] NULL; end

changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Issue_IssueTypeid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Issue_IssueTypeid] ON [dbo].[Issue] ( [IssueTypeID]) END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Issue_IssueTypeid') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_Issue_IssueTypeid] ON [dbo].[Issue] END

IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Issue_ObjectID_Object_CompletedOn') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_Issue_ObjectID_Object_CompletedOn] ON [dbo].[Issue] END
